value: A product site that sells what the team saves or wins, shows each point with a picture, and says only what ships today, with every claim traced to the code in a claims ledger.

howItWorks.title: Facts flow from the product branch to the page, and guards keep them true

workflow: Gather assets, the owner's strategy and the facts from the product's current branch.
Start a claims ledger: every claim with the file, test or doc that proves it.
Post a short spec with a visual per section, then build in rounds with a preview each.
Gate unreleased wording behind a build flag and let guard tests fail the build.
